item.title: Week 10: Dolphins at Colts
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: IND -4.5 · O/U 37.5 | Model IND 58% vs. market 66% | On paper Indianapolis has the edge (Indianapolis' defense ranks 10th in pressure rate, 23% generated), while Miami's best counter is to make them throw (Miami's defense ranks 24th in EPA per dropback, +0.06 allowed). Under center, Daniel Jones ranks 28th of 31 in EPA per dropback; x-factor: Malik Washington gets 23% of Miami's targets and 25% of its air yards, and His WOPR (0.52) ranks 33rd of 1211. Indianapolis' pass defense ranks 28th. The model favors Indianapolis at 58%, mostly on rushing matchup (3.5 pts) and home field (1.7 pts).
